name: a fresh shell opens as honey
the service agrees with the pre-paint stamp
and it is genuinely bright
text on it is ink, not grey
the page itself is painted bright
the empty-hive card kept a ground to sit on
and its text contrasts with that ground
elevation is lit, not sooty
the motion has a little spring
and it is quicker than the baseline
the theme says it is light
so the backdrop is bright too — on a DARK-OS machine
/theme offers the three looks beside light and dark
/background bloom dresses the chrome
/background bloom dresses the screen with it
bloom is bright
/background sherbet dresses the chrome
/background sherbet dresses the screen with it
sherbet is bright
a theme that names no chrome does not touch the panels
dark is still one word away
and the surface went dark with it
the card is still readable in dark
